Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class DummyDataService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.DummyDataService
public class DummyDataService extends Object
The application's data, split into per-area stores and backed by a local SQLite database ("data/marketplace.db").

Every store is saved to the database: users and listings (#55); deals, favourites and follows (#56); chats (#57); notifications, reviews, reports and the audit log (#58). The database is kept across restarts (#59); it is seeded with the demo data only when empty.
